sway 1.9 IPC replies, captured (not reconstructed) from the headless sway
1.9 (wlroots 0.17) of the dev container on 2026-10-07: `swaymsg -t
get_tree -r` and `swaymsg -t get_workspaces -r` with one output
(HEADLESS-1, 1920x1080) and one xdg toplevel (app_id `foot`, title
`TITLE_HERE`) mapped by the tests' TestWindow client
(tests/common/window.rs).

tests/sway.rs's fake sway serves these over the i3-ipc framing and puts
raw Latin-1 bytes where `TITLE_HERE` is, as sway's json-c output does for
an XWayland window whose WM_NAME is of type STRING (wlroots copies it
byte for byte; json-c escapes only control characters, quotes and `/`).

inputs.json (m6-service-gaps, gap 31) is reconstructed, not captured
(the dev container's headless sway has no input devices): `get_inputs`
as sway 1.9's ipc_json_describe_input (sway/ipc-json.c) writes it, with
a power button and a laptop keyboard (`keyboard`: repeat_delay,
repeat_rate, xkb_layout_names, xkb_active_layout_index,
xkb_active_layout_name; libinput devices: libinput, vendor, product)
and a touchpad (`touchpad`: scroll_factor), two layouts configured
(`input type:keyboard xkb_layout us,de`). An `input` event
(IPC_EVENT_INPUT, 0x80000015) is `{"change": …, "input": <one of
these>}`; tests/sway.rs builds its xkb_layout event from the keyboard.
The layout names a real sway gives a virtual keyboard's own keymap are
checked live by tests/sway.rs::sways_layout_is_the_active_keyboards.
